module_summary: AXI-stream protocol firewall: an input skid buffer feeds a registered output stage, while fault detectors (stalled-data change, optional packet length and stall timeout) latch o_fault, which drops input and cleanly terminates output packets.

anchors.name: o_fault
anchors.why: Sticky fault flag; once set, drains input and forces output packet termination.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Incoming stream valid into skid buffer and stall detection.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Incoming ready, low while skid register holds data.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Incoming stream data packed into idata.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Outgoing valid from skid output, suppressed or completed on fault.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Outgoing ready enabling output register updates.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Outgoing data from skid buffer, zeroed on fault.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TLAST
anchors.why: Output last, forced high to terminate a packet after fault.

anchors.name: skdr_data
anchors.why: Skid buffer register holding input beat when downstream stalls.

anchors.name: skdr_valid
anchors.why: Skid register occupied flag; deasserts S_AXIS_TREADY.

anchors.name: skd_ready
anchors.why: Internal ready from output stage, forced by fault conditions.

anchors.name: skd_valid
anchors.why: Internal skid output valid from input or skid register.

anchors.name: skd_data
anchors.why: Skid buffer output data muxed from input or register.

anchors.name: change_fault
anchors.why: Detects input data change while stalled; triggers o_fault.

anchors.name: r_stalled
anchors.why: Registers previous-cycle stall for change detection.

anchors.name: past_data
anchors.why: Previous input beat compared for stability check.

anchors.name: packet_fault
anchors.why: Packet length violation; disabled when OPT_PACKET_LENGTH is zero.

anchors.name: stall_fault
anchors.why: Stall timeout fault; disabled when OPT_MAX_STALL is zero.

anchors.name: m_idle
anchors.why: Output between packets; controls fault packet termination and self-reset.

groups.name: Input skid buffer
groups.description: Two-entry skid buffer decoupling input ready from output stall.

groups.name: Fault detector
groups.description: Detects protocol violations and latches sticky o_fault.

groups.name: Output stage
groups.description: Registered master stream, terminating packets cleanly on fault.
